findings.title: Release-day overlay census is measured but carries no pre-pinned breach rule
findings.evidence: Plan section 6 CLOCK-ONLY row: 'plus a fresh-extreme FIRING CENSUS (DOW/month/release-day overlay)'. R5 pins a kill threshold ONLY for the weekday share (0.35). A4 axis-3 demands both the DOW census AND the release-day overlay census ('If anchor edge concentrates on release days, the family is release-clock beta in new words'), but no numeric or decision rule for release-day concentration is frozen anywhere in the plan. An unpinned census on the plan's self-declared most lethal axis (NG4 daily-grid class) is a decorative-census risk: it can be measured at D2 and then adjudicated by judgment, which is a retro-device surface.
findings.remediation: At or before the P0 manifest freeze (same freeze event as the 0.35 floor), pre-pin the release-day adjudication: either a numeric release-day concentration kill floor, or an explicit declaration that any measured release-day concentration is kill-only evidence feeding R5/R6 adjudication with the rule stated before the census is read. Fold into the D1 freeze text.

findings.title: R0 kill-condition conjunction is ambiguous; literal AND-kill could let a pooled-only breach survive
findings.evidence: R0 reads: 'per-leg AND pooled |rho| > 0.20 ... -> dies pre-score'. Under a literal conjunctive-kill reading, a shadow with pooled |rho| > 0.20 but all per-leg |rho| <= 0.20 would survive R0, contradicting the round-1 demand that PASS require BOTH per-leg AND pooled <= 0.20. The demanded semantics exist verbatim in the USD-DRIFT GATE and R6, and pooled-only runs are explicitly foreclosed, so the residual is a wording loophole in one binding kill rule, not a missing gate. Note pooled correlation across stacked legs is not bounded by the per-leg range, so the loophole case is reachable.
findings.remediation: Rewrite R0 in conjunctive-pass form: 'PASS requires per-leg |rho| <= 0.20 AND pooled |rho| <= 0.20 for every shadow; breach of EITHER measurement kills pre-score.' Fold into the D1 freeze text before any rho is measured.

findings.title: Cost floor unit stated per-fill vs A4's round-trip framing; TD-entitlement precedent citation imprecise
findings.evidence: F4/section 8: 'conservative 1.5 bps/fill FLOOR band ... charged once per fill'; A4 axis-4 frames 'the 1.5 bps round-trip floor' and derives the 3.0 bps stress-2.0 hurdle from it. Per-fill charging doubles the round-trip drag and is therefore the STRICTER direction (can only kill more, never rescue), so no door is opened — but the P0-pinned band must state the unit explicitly to keep break-even-bps comparisons per arm well-defined. Separately, F2 cites 'owner TD entitlement (V8/V9/NG5 precedent)': V8/V9 were free-source cycles; the TD spot entitlement precedent is the NG1/NG5 lineage (NG1 A1 ruling AUTHORIZED_INTERNAL_RESEARCH with terms-gap disclosed).
findings.remediation: State the cost-band unit (per fill vs per round trip) at the P0 band pinning; correct the entitlement precedent citation to NG1/NG5.
